goal: Ensure subtree merge commits can be reused verbatim when backporting to maintenance branches
Save maintainers from having to verify newly generated subtree merges for every release branch
agreement: Contested objection: bash logic adds maintenance overhead for a style preference (maflcko)
Support because it simplifies backport verification and documents good practice (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing that the check and override flag behave as expected (BrandonOdiwuor)
Questioned whether checking backportability should be the default behavior (sedited)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it improves internal repository hygiene for subtree maintenance
The benefit affects an internal developer workflow and is reasonably deferrable
